GRAMMAR 2, 13-UNIT MAShQLAR, 2-BET (64-bet, PDF 63). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '13'.

CHAP USTUN:
5) 'Use the prompts and the key below to make sentences, as in the example.' KALIT: love ♥♥♥, enjoy ♥♥, like ♥, don't like ✗, can't stand ✗✗, hate ✗✗✗, don't mind ○. RASMLAR bilan: 1 James (○ cook) - James doesn't mind cooking. (qozon) 2 Andrew (♥♥ fly) kites (varrak) 3 My father (✗✗ deep-sea dive) (sho'ng'ish jihozi) 4 Tom (✗ collect) old records (plastinkalar) 5 He (○ feed) the cat (mushuk) 6 Pamela (✗✗✗ do) the housework (chelak) 7 She (♥♥♥ solve) arithmetic problems (raqamlar) 8 I (♥ eat) chocolate (shokolad) 9 Most people (✗✗✗ visit) the dentist (tish shifokori) 10 Carol (○ make) her bed (yotoq)
6) 'What do you love/enjoy/like/hate doing? What don't you like/mind doing? What can't you stand doing? Write sentences about yourself.'

O'NG USTUN:
7) 'Using the prompts below say what your teacher lets, doesn't let or makes you do in class, as in the example.' SURAT: bolalar doskaga yozishyapti. • write on the walls • play games during our break • use a pen • stay after school if we haven't done our homework • chew gum in class • write a composition twice a week • clean out our desks every Friday. Our teacher doesn't let us write on the walls.
8) 'Read the letter below and put the verbs in brackets into the correct infinitive or -ing form.' SURAT: juftlik. Dear Sue, How are you? I wanted 1) ...... (write) to you because I've got some great news. Do you remember 2) ...... (meet) Peter? He's my brother's best friend. He made you 3) ...... (laugh) all the time when you came to visit last year. Well, guess what? We've decided 4) ...... (get) married at Christmas and would love you 5) ...... (be) there. Let me 6) ...... (know) if you can come. I look forward to 7) ...... (hear) from you. Love, Kate. PS Of course, you can 8) ...... (bring) a guest if you like.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '64'.

exercises.explanationUz:
BELGI → FE'L + -ING.

  ♥♥♥ love    ✗ don't like
  ♥♥ enjoy    ✗✗ can't stand
  ♥ like      ✗✗✗ hate
  ○ don't mind

  3-shaxs: loves, enjoys, likes,
  doesn't like, hates, doesn't
  mind.


⚠ 'TO FLY KITES':

  = varrak uchirmoq.


⚠ 'ARITHMETIC PROBLEMS':

  = arifmetik masalalar.

exercises.instructionEn: What do you love/enjoy/like/hate doing? What don't you like/mind doing? What can't you stand doing? Write sentences about yourself.
exercises.instructionUz: Nima qilishni yaxshi ko'rasiz / zavqlanasiz / yoqtirasiz / yomon ko'rasiz? Nimani yoqtirmaysiz / qarshi emassiz? Nimaga chiday olmaysiz? O'zingiz haqingizda gaplar yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZIM HAQIMDA - 7 TA FE'L + -ING.

  I love ...ing / I enjoy ...ing /
  I like ...ing / I hate ...ing / I
  don't like ...ing / I don't mind
  ...ing / I can't stand ...ing
exercises.exampleUz: Men futbol o'ynashni juda yaxshi ko'raman.
modelAnswers: I love playing football with my friends.
I enjoy listening to music.
I like reading books in the evening.
I hate getting up early.
I don't like doing the washing-up.
I don't mind helping my mother in the kitchen.
I can't stand waiting for the bus.
modelAnswersUz: Men do'stlarim bilan futbol o'ynashni juda yaxshi ko'raman.
Men onamga oshxonada yordam berishga qarshi emasman.

exercises.instructionEn: Using the prompts below say what your teacher lets, doesn't let or makes you do in class, as in the example. • write on the walls • play games during our break • use a pen • stay after school if we haven't done our homework • chew gum in class • write a composition twice a week • clean out our desks every Friday. Example: Our teacher doesn't let us write on the walls.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan o'qituvchingiz sinfda sizga nimaga ruxsat berishini, bermasligini yoki nimani qildirishini ayting, namunadagidek. • devorga yozish • tanaffusda o'yin o'ynash • ruchka ishlatish • uy vazifasini qilmagan bo'lsak darsdan keyin qolish • sinfda saqich chaynash • haftada ikki marta insho yozish • har juma partalarni tozalash. Namuna: O'qituvchimiz devorga yozishga ruxsat bermaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
LETS (ruxsat) / DOESN'T LET
  (taqiq) / MAKES (majbur) + US +
  FE'L (to siz).

  1 doesn't let us write on the
    walls (NAMUNA)
  2 lets us play games during our
    break
  3 lets us use a pen
  4 makes us stay after school
  5 doesn't let us chew gum
  6 makes us write a composition
  7 makes us clean out our desks


⚠ 'TO CHEW GUM':

  = saqich chaynamoq.


⚠ 'A COMPOSITION':

  = insho.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter below and put the verbs in brackets into the correct infinitive or -ing form.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi xatni o'qing va qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri infinitiv yoki -ing shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
KEYTNING XATI - TO'YGA TAKLIF.

  1 wanted TO WRITE
  2 remember MEETING (o'tgan -
    eslaysanmi)
  3 made you LAUGH (to siz)
  4 decided TO GET married
  5 would love you TO BE there
  6 Let me KNOW (to siz)
  7 look forward to HEARING
  8 can BRING (modal - to siz)


⚠ 'GUESS WHAT?':

  = bilasanmi nima? (yangilik
  oldidan).


⚠ 'TO GET MARRIED':

  = turmush qurmoq.


⚠ 'PS' (postscript):

  = xat oxiridagi qo'shimcha.

items.textEn: Dear Sue, How are you? I wanted ___ (write) to you because I've got some great news.
Do you remember ___ (meet) Peter? He's my brother's best friend.
He made you ___ (laugh) all the time when you came to visit last year.
Well, guess what? We've decided ___ (get) married at Christmas
Let me ___ (know) if you can come.
I look forward to ___ (hear) from you. Love, Kate
PS Of course, you can ___ (bring) a guest if you like.

patterns.formula: KIM + loves / enjoys / likes / doesn't like / can't stand / hates / doesn't mind + FE'L-ing
patterns.exampleEn: Andrew enjoys flying kites. Pamela hates doing the housework.
patterns.exampleUz: Endryu varrak uchirishdan zavqlanadi. Pamela uy ishlarini yomon ko'radi.

patterns.formula: Our teacher lets / doesn't let / makes us + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Our teacher lets us use a pen. Our teacher makes us write a composition.
patterns.exampleUz: O'qituvchimiz ruchka ishlatishga ruxsat beradi. O'qituvchimiz insho yozdiradi.

patterns.formula: Do you remember + FE'L-ing ...? / We've decided to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Do you remember meeting Peter? We've decided to get married.
patterns.exampleUz: Piter bilan uchrashganingni eslaysanmi? Biz turmush qurishga qaror qildik.
